name: Qian Zhai
description: Documented New Zealand GIS and spatial-information contribution, 2002.
story: Qian Zhai prepared the 2002 Massey University dissertation 'A development and application of GIS in Whanganui Catchment based river environment classification system', for a Master in Resource and Environmental Planning.

The dissertation's title page and date document an early-2000s New Zealand application of geographic information systems to river-environment classification. The work is associated with the Whanganui catchment. A later professional profile describes terrain modelling and ARC/INFO work, but those claims are not needed to establish this entry and are not treated as independently verified.
